content_sections.heading: About TNPDCL
content_sections.text: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Ltd is a power distribution company. Its Chief Engineer - Personnel works in Chennai. The Board of Apprenticeship Training, Southern Region (BOAT (SR)), Chennai, runs this apprenticeship programme with TNPDCL.

content_sections.heading: TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year in every discipline. TNPDCL can increase or decrease the number of vacancies, whatever figure the notification gives. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwD follows the guidelines under the Apprentices Act. If you claim reservation, you must provide a certificate in the Government standard format. Without it, you will be treated as a 'General' category candidate. BC/MBC candidates who claim the OBC (Non-creamy layer) category must bring an OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format from the certificate issuing authority. Up to 10% of the vacancies are reserved (horizontal reservation) for wards of regular (permanent) employees of TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO. Wards of contract, temporary, casual or retired employees cannot use this quota. Ward quota places that are not filled will go to other available candidates under the usual procedures. content_sections.heading: TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: As per the Apprenticeship Rules. Domicile and year of passing: You must be from Tamil Nadu and must have passed your engineering diploma in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or May 2026. Minimum educational qualification (Category - I Technician (Diploma) Apprentices), any one of: A Diploma in Engineering or Technology (Regular - Full time) in the relevant discipline, granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education set up by a State Government. A Diploma in Engineering or Technology (Regular - Full time) in the relevant discipline, granted by a University. A Diploma in Engineering and Technology granted by an institution that the State Government or Central Government recognises as equivalent to the above. Candidates with higher qualifications (B.E / B.Tech. and above) are not wanted for Diploma Apprentice selection. Previous training or experience: You cannot apply if you have already done, or are now doing, an apprenticeship under NATS 2.0 / NAPS (Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973) or PMIS Internship Training. You also cannot apply if you have one year or more of work experience. Physical standards: As set out in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rule 1992 and any later amendments. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: BOAT (SR) draws up a shortlist from the online application data. It is based on your percentage of marks in the basic qualification for your discipline. Intimation: Shortlisted candidates are told by email, at the email address they registered on the portal. Certificate verification: Shortlisted candidates must attend certificate verification at the TNPDCL office. The shortlist goes up on nats.education.gov.in . To find it, go to the bottom of the home page, then Regional Events, then BOAT (Southern Region), then Apprenticeship News. The notice asks students to check there every day.

content_sections.heading: Training Conditions
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year, as per the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973. When the apprenticeship ends, TNPDCL (TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO) has no obligation to offer you a job. Finishing the apprenticeship does not give you a right to employment. No TA / DA is paid for attending certificate verification, and no boarding or lodging expenses are paid. Incomplete or wrong online applications, and applications received after the due date, will be rejected. No further communication about them will be entertained. Canvassing or putting pressure through any source will disqualify you. Your name will be removed from the records without notice. BOAT (SR) has not authorised any person or organisation to coordinate or liaise its work, so beware of touts.

faq.question: Q1. How many places are there in each discipline?
faq.answer: Electrical and Electronics Engineering has 455 places, Electronics and Communication Engineering has 35, and Computer Engineering / Information Technology has 10.

faq.question: Q2. Which years of diploma passing are accepted?
faq.answer: Diplomas passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and May 2026 are accepted. You must also be from Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q3. Can B.E or B.Tech graduates apply?
faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates with higher qualifications (B.E / B.Tech. and above) are not wanted for Diploma Apprentice selection.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. BOAT (SR) shortlists candidates on their percentage of marks in the diploma. Shortlisted candidates then attend certificate verification at the TNPDCL office, tentatively in the fourth week of December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. I did a NAPS apprenticeship earlier. Can I apply?
faq.answer: No. Anyone who has done or is doing a NATS 2.0 / NAPS apprenticeship or PMIS Internship Training cannot apply, and neither can anyone with one year or more of experience.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if I don't enter my percentage of marks?
faq.answer: Your application will not be considered. Entering your diploma percentage in the "% of marks" column is compulsory.

faq.question: Q7. Who can use the 10% ward quota?
faq.answer: Only wards of regular (permanent) employees of TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO. They show the Annexure 'A' Ward Certificate and a copy of the parent's ID card at certificate verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the shortlist be published?
faq.answer: On nats.education.gov.in, under Regional Events, BOAT (Southern Region), Apprenticeship News, in the second week of December 2026. Shortlisted candidates are also told by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance paid for certificate verification?
faq.answer: No. No TA / DA is paid, and no boarding or lodging expenses are given.
